synthesizedFacts.fact: Mineral sunscreens are generally better tolerated by sensitive skin compared to chemical sunscreens.
Sunscreens with broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays are essential for preventing sunburn and premature aging.
Hypoallergenic and fragrance-free sunscreens are less likely to cause irritation in sensitive skin.
EltaMD UV Skin Recovery Red Color Correcting Green Tint SPF 50 is highly recommended for sensitive skin due to its redness-neutralizing properties.
